explication: PrusaSlicer is a desktop and command-line application that turns FDM or mSLA 3D models into printer instructions and can transfer jobs to printers. The documented user workflow is to configure and modify a project, arrange models, generate and inspect the print, then export or send it. The graph preserves the README’s major capabilities, including multi-bed projects, per-layer settings, multi-material work, preview, and optional online integrations. Several capabilities are documented but their implementation files were not sampled, so those links cite the README; sampled source also shows launcher dispatch and PrusaLink storage-choice handling.
